name: driftwave
description: A look-before-you-act coding loop for Claude Code: check what's there, what's asked, and the gap — then do it and verify. Clusters artifacts with H₀ persistent homology (real); the higher 'sheaf'/'H₁' layers are topology-inspired LLM heuristics. Guided by five axioms: NO_AVERAGING, UPWARD_FLOW, WAYPOINT_ROUTING, SHAPE_OVER_COUNT, ADAPTIVE_SCALE.
